page.layout: One block of verse in italic, set right of centre, with a page number above it; below it a catchword-style word at the right and a woodcut ornament (diamond-shaped fleuron) with no text.

main_text.l: Pugnas edit,& arua liquentia, perfido cruore
Multiplici, merito diru in caput ante coparatam
Maturat poenas domino scelus,& propinqua turpes
Nec maius Clariis vnquam decus ambulauit oris

page.notes: The page number "10" is printed at top left. The word "TRIVM-" is set in capitals at the right below the verse; it is a catchword in form, though it is set well above the foot. The ornament is a woodcut fleuron with no text. Faint show-through from the reverse page is visible in the right margin and was omitted. Verse lines are kept as printed; the first line is set flush left and the second and later lines are indented per the printed layout, so the lines are given as <l> elements.
